scholarships.name: Entry Scholarship
eligibility: Students may receive this award only once.
Only those students who have been approved and received a scholarship confirmation letter will be eligible to receive the scholarship amount once they have enrolled in their full-time program.
scholarships.availability: Scholarships are awarded based on availability.
payment_notes: The entrance scholarship will be deposited directly to your Fleming College student account in a few weeks after the 10th day of class.
